sections.heading: HONOURS SPECIALIZATION IN KINESIOLOGY - SPORT MANAGEMENT - admission discontinued
lines: Faculty of Health Sciences - Kinesiology, School of
Admission to this module is discontinued effective September 1, 2022. Students enrolled in the module will be permitted to graduate upon fulfillment of the module requirements by August 31, 2026.

Completion of first-year requirements with no course grade less than 60% on a full course load. Students must have an average of at least 70% in 5.0 course load and 70% in 3.0 principal courses, with no mark in these principal courses below 60%, including Kinesiology 1080A/B and Kinesiology 1070A/B or the former Kinesiology 1088A/B, Physiology 1021, and Business Administration 1220E.
Notes:

1. The Honours Specialization in Kinesiology - Sport Management is a limited enrollment program. More competitive academic standing may be required when demand exceeds enrollment capacity. Admission to the module is restricted to students registered in the School of Kinesiology.

2. The admission, progression requirements and course selections for the "Honours Specialization in Kinesiology - Sport Management" and the "Combined Bachelor of Arts Honours Specialization in Kinesiology-Sport Management / Honours Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration" are not the same. Students are admitted into one program or the other and must follow the program requirements accordingly.
Module
10.5 courses:
2.5 courses: Kinesiology 2222A/B, Kinesiology 2230A/B, Kinesiology 2241A/B, Kinesiology 2250A/B, Kinesiology 2298A/B (must be taken in second year).

1.0 courses from: Kinesiology 2900-2999, Kinesiology 3900-3999, Dance 2174A/B, Dance 2274A/B, Dance 2275A/B, Dance 2276A/B, Dance 2375A/B. A minimum/maximum of four activity quarter courses [or equivalent] must be selected in second year.
0.5 courses: Writing 2111F/G.
1.5 courses: Kinesiology 2032A/B, Kinesiology 3398F/G, Kinesiology 3399F/G.
1.0 course: Kinesiology 4489A/B, Kinesiology 4498A/B.

4.0 additional Kinesiology courses at the 2000 level or above (non activity based), of which at least 1.0 course must be selected from: Kinesiology 2263F/G, Kinesiology 2276F/G, Kinesiology 2292F/G, Kinesiology 3490F/G, Kinesiology 3510F/G, Kinesiology 4459A/B, Kinesiology 4460F/G.
For module planning guide go to the School of Kinesiology website: http://www.uwo.ca/fhs/kin/
Note: All students must complete a Statistics course as a pre or co requisite to Kinesiology 2032A/B.
Note: All Honours Specialization modules in Kinesiology require the successful completion of a least 1.0 4000-level Kinesiology credits prior to graduation.
Note: A maximum of 12.5 Kinesiology Credits may be taken in any Honours Specialization degree or module
